_readme: Site-wide facts used in the legal and info pages. Fill these in before applying to AdSense — the placeholders are deliberately obvious so an unfinished policy cannot ship unnoticed.
_adsense: Leave empty to ship with no ads and no third-party requests. Set to your ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX id to inject the AdSense tag and generate ads.txt. Google's certified CMP is then enabled from the AdSense dashboard under Privacy & messaging — it is delivered through this same tag, so no separate consent script is needed.
_analytics: Google Analytics 4 measurement id, or empty for no analytics at all. Changing this means the privacy policy in all six locales must match reality.
